idea.name: JC Print Farm: niche 3D-printed products and fulfillment
idea.one_liner: Designs and sells its own niche 3D-printed products, while also taking B2B production runs and print-on-demand fulfillment work.
idea.customer: Consumers in niche hobby communities seeking functional or personalized printed items; businesses and designers needing larger or outsourced production runs.
idea.offer: Design and sell proprietary accessories, sculptures and custom busts; print, assemble and fulfill client-owned designs.
idea.revenue_model: Marketplace and direct e-commerce product sales, B2B production fees and print-on-demand fulfillment fees.

acquisition_channels.details: Sells through Etsy, Amazon, eBay and Shopify; the guest says Etsy helped surface products and Amazon drove more volume.
Ran Google Ads for local B2B work and Meta ads toward a small Shopify catalog.
Posted on Reddit and Facebook; the company has YouTube and Facebook content, and YouTubers have reviewed products.
Some B2B customers found the company through online search; the guest also mentions organic search results.
Some YouTuber reviews and customer posts brought attention; the host recommended influencer affiliates as a further channel.

ideas.delivery: The company creates digital designs, prints items on demand from filament, and handles assembly, post-processing, packaging and shipping. Its staff operate the printers and production systems; some products are also sent through Amazon FBA.

prices: About $1,000 per printer initially; later $1,400 after tariffs and $500 current
platforms: TikTok Shop (recommended by the host, not stated as implemented)
